---
title: "Assignments"
description: "Assignment deliverables, artifacts, and technical evidence."
---

::: {.workbench-page data-page="assignments" data-default-type="Assignment"}
<section class="page-head">
<p class="eyebrow">Assignment Archive</p>
<h1>Assignments</h1>
<p>Reports, notebooks, code, figures, and submissions organized for fast review.</p>
</section>

<section class="command-row compact" role="search">
<label class="sr-only" for="assignment-search">Search assignments</label>
<input id="assignment-search" class="work-search" type="search" placeholder="Search assignments..." autocomplete="off">
<div class="filter-set" aria-label="Assignment filters">
<button class="filter-chip is-active" type="button" data-filter="Assignment">Assignments</button>
</div>
</section>

<section id="assignment-table" class="work-table-wrap" data-table-type="Assignment" aria-live="polite"></section>
<section id="work-grid" class="work-grid tight" data-card-type="Assignment" aria-live="polite"></section>
:::
